facts.fact: 本章以 Scrooge 的一句喊叫开场，喊的是"别让她进来"
facts.anchor: Don’t let her… don’t let her in!

facts.fact: 守夜的三人是医生 Tarkin、俱乐部书记员 Bentinck 先生和女仆 Charlotte
facts.anchor: Doctor Tarkin, who had returned; the Club secretary, Mr Bentinck: and that redoubtable maidservant, Charlotte.

facts.fact: 医生让另外两人留在门外，自己先进去照料
facts.anchor: “Stay here,” said the doctor to both of the others. “Let’s not crowd the poor fellow. Just allow me to attend on him at first.”

facts.fact: 医生与书记员被定住，只有 Charlotte 还能动
facts.anchor: Only Charlotte seemed to have agency, only she seemed free to move around.

facts.fact: 屋里的来客是深沉的男声，问 Scrooge 是否愿意跟他们去
facts.anchor: It was a deep, male voice which sounded full of age and wisdom. “Ebenezer. They need your help. Will you go to them?”

facts.fact: Scrooge 答应了"带我到他们那里"
facts.anchor: Then, overheard, the voice of Ebenezer Scrooge: “Yes, Spirit, take me to them.”

facts.fact: 强光之后房间空了，只剩一团乱毯
facts.anchor: The room was empty, the bed untenanted. There was only a tangle of blankets

facts.fact: Charlotte 判断 Scrooge 正在他最该在的地方
facts.anchor: it’s my suspicion that Mr Scrooge is now precisely where he needs to be
